working_tree.note: The legacy suite regenerates its own quick-run JSON result files; these are restored after a milestone run. Untracked EXP-H result files are preserved untouched per explicit authorization; they are not EXP-L artifacts.

L1.note: Semantic targets are held out of the reference library. Feature drift is reported separately and never counted as semantic-drift detection.

L2.note: Intermediate checkpoints are task specification data; hidden program, held-out test labels and first-error diagnostics are never passed to decide().

L3.note: Recall@k is measured only where a correct concept exists in the pool; held-out recall is undefined and is not reported as a success score.
